title: CANcestry HAL configuration (v0.1.0)
description: Schema for the CANcestry Hardware Abstraction Layer configuration file (Phase 6, issue #17). Declares the set of physical CAN interfaces the gateway binds at startup, their bitrates, and optional listen-only mode. All strings must validate against this schema before being accepted by the runtime; configuration that fails validation is refused (fail-closed).

name.description: OS interface name (e.g., 'can0', 'vcan1'). Must match SIOCGIFINDEX naming rules.

interface_id.description: CANcestry logical interface id used by codecs, recipes and FSMs. Must be unique within the configuration.

bitrate.description: Nominal bitrate in bits per second. 125000, 250000, 500000 are typical CAN values.

listen_only.description: When true the interface is opened in listen-only mode; hal_send_tx returns ERR_NO_INTERFACE for this interface.
